meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: mLST8 is dispensable for mTORC1 in vivo but essential for mTORC2 - a rare clean genetic separation of the two complexes.
data.mechanism_beginner: This protein isn't needed for mTORC1 in a living animal, but mTORC2 can't work without it – a clean genetic way to tell the two complexes apart.
data.boundary: Knockout mice (GUE2006) and human cell biochemistry (KIM2003). The separation of the two complexes is shown in mouse tissue; whether it holds in human tissue is not tested by these studies.
data.note: The cleanest genetic argument that the two complexes are truly separate machines.
